newsitem.title: USA: Air Transport, Piedmont say plan to merge.
newsitem.headline: Air Transport, Piedmont say plan to merge.

text.p: Air Transportation Holding Co Inc and Piedmont Holding Co Inc said they intended to merge in a deal in which shareholders of Piedmont would receive a combination of cash and Air Transport stock.
According to a statement released by the two companies, the deal values both companies in excess of $54,800,000.
Consummation of the non-binding letter of intent is subject approval by the board of directors of both companies and execution of a definitive agreement.
The agreement will be subject, among other things, to obtaining required regulatory clearance, as well as other customary conditions.
